The traditional use of organ meats throughout history suggests they offer a complex array of nutrients that work together in ways we’re still studying.

settings.repere: Paragraphe · How many capsules are in a bottle of FEM
settings.text: How many capsules are in a bottle of FEM, and how many should I take each day?

settings.repere: Paragraphe · Alright, let’s get down to it. Each bott
settings.text: Alright, let’s get down to it. Each bottle of FEM comes packed with 180 capsules, each containing 500mg of hormone-balancing goodness. Now, when it comes to how many to take daily, we recommend a serving size of 6 capsules. That means each bottle gives you a full 30-day supply to get you feeling your best. Consider it your daily hormone reset to reverse hormone chaos.

settings.repere: Paragraphe · If you know that you are sensitive to su
settings.text: If you know that you are sensitive to supplements and/or you have an autoimmune condition, consult with your healthcare provider before using this product. If your healthcare provider approves, you may wish to start slowly when adding this product to your current regimen. Tolerability can be greatly improved by starting with just 1 or 2 capsules a day and increasing by just 1 capsule every couple of days – this method may take a full few weeks to achieve the desired serving size of 6 capsules per day.

settings.text: If you know that you’re ultra-sensitive to supplements, email us and we’ll do everything we can to help.
